style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel shading, calm colors, slightly dark lighting, subtle washi paper texture.
avoid_en: 文字、ロゴ、現代の建物や服、裸、肌の多い服、血

echo.desc_en: Echo, a mountain nymph of ancient Greek myth, a slender young woman about 18 years old, long wavy light brown hair with a few small green leaves in it, a pale sage-green ankle-length chiton that fully covers her chest, shoulders and arms to the elbow, a soft grey-green himation shawl, simple leather sandals, shy gentle grey eyes, no crown, no jewelry except a thin leaf circlet

narcissus.desc_en: Narcissus, a beautiful youth of ancient Greek myth about 16 years old, short wavy dark blond hair, fair face with long eyelashes, a white knee-length chiton that fully covers his chest and shoulders, a dark blue chlamys cloak pinned at one shoulder, leather sandals laced to the shin, a light hunting spear, proud cool expression (Classical Greek period)

cuts.image: 夜の暗い森の中の泉。左側に、ナルキッソスがひざをつき、水面に映る自分の顔にうっとり見とれている。右側の木の陰から、エコーが涙をためた目で彼を見つめ、口元に手を当てて声を出せずにいる。2人の顔に月の光が当たって明るく、まわりは暗い。2人は画面の上下の真ん中の高さに大きく描き、画面の上の4分の1と下の4分の1は、暗い木の葉と暗い水だけで何も描かない
cuts.image_en: A spring in a dark forest at night. On the left, Narcissus kneels at the water's edge, enchanted by his own reflection on the surface. On the right, from behind a tree trunk, Echo the nymph watches him with tear-filled eyes, a hand at her lips, unable to speak. Moonlight falls on both faces so they are bright; everything around is dark. Draw both large at the vertical middle of the frame; the top quarter and the bottom quarter of the image contain only dark leaves and dark water, nothing else.

cuts.image: 暗い山の洞窟の入口に、エコーがひとり立ち、驚いたような悲しい顔でこちらを振り返っている。体の下半分が灰色の岩と同じ色に薄れ始めている。顔に青白い光が当たって明るく、まわりは暗い。人物は画面の上下の真ん中の高さに大きく描き、画面の上の4分の1と下の4分の1は、暗い岩だけで何も描かない
cuts.image_en: At the mouth of a dark mountain cave, Echo the nymph stands alone and looks back toward the viewer with a startled, sorrowful face; the lower half of her body is beginning to fade into the same grey as the rocks. Pale light falls on her face so it is bright; everything around is dark. Draw her large at the vertical middle of the frame; the top quarter and bottom quarter contain only dark rock, nothing else.
